resources.string: History and backups
Encrypted copies include messages, photos, videos, voice messages and files. Keep your recovery key separately.
No confirmed backup on this server
An encrypted backup is stored on this server
Last confirmed copy
An unfinished upload exists. It is not a usable backup. Delete it before preparing a new key.
Recovery key saved securely on this phone
No recovery key saved on this phone
This key is only for history. It is not your account password or a six-digit sign-in code. Keep it outside UNYRI: without it, an encrypted backup cannot be opened. The server never receives this key.
Prepare recovery key
Save the entire key in a password manager or write it down. Then enter its last 8 characters to confirm. This draft expires after 10 minutes.
Copy recovery key
Last 8 characters
I saved the key
Enter the recovery key saved when the backup was created. UNYRI will verify it without importing or changing your messages.
History recovery key
Verify and save key
The operation could not be completed. Check your connection and recovery key, then refresh. Existing keys are never replaced automatically.
Use the complete key beginning with COCO-H1-, including all eight groups.
This key cannot open the backup. Check that you entered the history recovery key for this account and server.
This server does not support history backups yet. Ask its owner to update the server.
The unsaved key draft expired. Prepare a new key.
Disable future backup uploads
Allow future backup uploads
Backup uploads disabled. Existing copies are kept.
Delete server backup
The server copy will be permanently deleted and future uploads disabled. Messages on your phones and the recovery key will remain. This cannot be undone.
Back up now
Restore messages and files
Preparing, transferring and verifying. Keep this screen open.
Completed successfully.
Wait for pending messages to finish, or cancel them. Unreadable messages must be restored with the correct key before creating a complete copy.
History changed during copying. Try again; the previous confirmed copy is safe.
A file could not be downloaded. Check the connection and try again. The previous confirmed copy is safe.
There is not enough free space for safe verification. Free some storage and try again.
Messages and files will be downloaded and checked before importing. Newer messages stay on this phone; saved deletion and hide actions are also applied. Keep this screen open.
1 of 3 · Save your recovery key
Start here. Save the recovery key outside UNYRI. Then you can create a copy of your messages and files.
1 of 3 · Confirm your saved key
Copy or write down the entire key below, then enter its last 8 characters. Preparing a key does not upload your history.
Enter the key for your existing backup
This server already has a backup. Enter its saved recovery key below. A new key cannot open the old copy.
An upload was interrupted
The earlier upload is not a confirmed backup. Refresh its status or remove the unfinished server copy below. Messages on this phone stay in place.
2 of 3 · Allow encrypted backups
Your key is saved. Allow encrypted uploads to create or update a backup. An existing copy can still be restored while uploads are off.
3 of 3 · Create your first backup
The key is saved and uploads are allowed. Tap Back up now. Keep UNYRI open until it finishes.
Your backup is ready
Your encrypted copy is stored on the server. Keep your recovery key outside UNYRI; signing in alone does not restore history.
Enter and verify your saved key above before restoring.
Save your recovery key and allow uploads before enabling automatic backup.
